newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKANS MISS ALL-TIME PARTNERSHIP RECO.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKANS MISS ALL-TIME PARTNERSHIP RECO.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Sanath Jayasuriya and Roshan Mahanama failed by one run to equal the all-time partnership record in first class matches when Mahanama was out for 225 on the fifth and final day of the first test against India at Colombo.

Mahanama was trapped leg before by Anil Kumble. The two batsmen put on 576 runs for the second wicket, missing the previous all-time high record of 577 set by V.S.Hazare and Gul Mohammed for Baroda against Holkar in 1946-47.
